title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of self-realisation and inner strength
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the transformative power of self-realisation. He emphasised that knowing one’s true self awakens infinite inner strength and confidence, helps overcome mental anguish and guides one towards profound peace and liberation. Sharing a Sanskrit Subhashitam, Shri Modi wrote on X; “प्रतिबोधविदितं मतममृतत्वं हि विन्दते। आत्मना विन्दते वीर्यं विद्यया विन्दतेऽमृतम्॥” प्रतिबोधविदितं मतममृतत्वं हि विन्दते।

आत्मना विन्दते वीर्यं विद्यया विन्दतेऽमृतम्॥ https://t.co/eKFWbxAdMk — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 4, 2026 ***** MJPS/SS/ST
